'''Rémi Abgrall''' (born 1961) is a French applied mathematician. He is known for his contributions in [[computational fluid dynamics]], numerical analysis of [[conservation laws]], [[multiphase flow]] and [[Hamilton–Jacobi equations]].<ref>[https://www.inria.fr/en/remi-abgrall-addecco-radically-changing-models-dynamics''Rémi Abgrall: Addecco, radically changing models in dynamics'']</ref><ref>[https://www.siam.org/prizes-recognition/fellows-program/all-siam-fellows/class-of-2022''Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics, Fellows Program, nomination for outstanding contributions to the field.'']</ref> He has been editor in chief of the [[Journal of Computational Physics]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-computational-physics/journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-computational-physics/editorial-board|title=Editorial Board - Journal of Computational Physics - Journal - Elsevier|website=www.journals.elsevier.com}}</ref> since 2015 and is part of the editorial board of several international scientific journals. In 2014 he was invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematics]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.icm2014.org/en/participants/registration/participants.html|title=International Congress of Mathematicians|website=www.icm2014.org}}</ref> in [[Seoul]]. He is author of more than 100 scientific papers published in international scientific journals.<ref>[https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/245762''American Mathematical Society'']</ref> He is editor of 4 books<ref>{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=VwyPRAAACAAJ | title=Hypersonic Flows for Reentry Problems: Volume 3: Proceedings of the INRIA-GAMNI/SMAI Workshop on Hypersonic Flows for Reentry Problems, Part II, Antibes, France, 15–19 April 1991 | isbn=978-3-540-56189-7 | last1=Abgrall | first1=Remi | last2=Desideri | first2=Jean-Antoine | last3=Glowinski | first3=Roland | last4=Mallet | first4=Michel | last5=Périaux | first5=Jacques | date=22 January 1993 | publisher=Springer }}</ref><ref>{{cite book | url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-319-05455-1 | doi=10.1007/978-3-319-05455-1 | title=High Order Nonlinear Numerical Schemes for Evolutionary PDEs | series=Lecture Notes in Computational Science and Engineering | date=2014 | volume=99 | isbn=978-3-319-05454-4 }}</ref><ref>[https://www.sciencedirect.com/handbook/handbook-of-numerical-analysis/vol/17/suppl/C''XVII Handbook of Numerical Methods for Hyperbolic Problems'']</ref><ref>[https://www.sciencedirect.com/handbook/handbook-of-numerical-analysis/vol/18/suppl/C''XVIII Handbook of Numerical Methods for Hyperbolic Problems'']</ref> and author of one book<ref>{{Cite book |title=Residual Distribution Schemes for Conservation Laws Via Adaptive Quadrature |isbn=978-1287283096 |id={{ASIN|1287283098|country=de}}}}</ref> on advanced topics concerning [[computational fluid dynamics]], [[high-resolution scheme]]s and [[conservation laws]].

== Education and career ==

Abgrall received his degree in mathematics at [[École normale supérieure de Saint-Cloud]] in 1985 and his PhD at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in 1987 with a thesis entitled ''Conception d’un modèle semi-lagrangien de turbulence bidimensionnelle''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=80484|title=Rémi Abgrall - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref> He worked at [[ONERA]] and then at [[Inria]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.inria.fr/en/remi-abgrall|title=Rémi Abgrall &#124; Inria|website=www.inria.fr}}</ref> as a research scientist. From 1996 until 2013 he was professor at [[University of Bordeaux 1]] and then at [[Institut polytechnique de Bordeaux]]. Since 2014, he has been a professor of [[numerical analysis]] at the [[University of Zurich]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.math.uzh.ch/index.php?id=people&key1=8882|title=UZH - Institute of Mathematics - Person|website=www.math.uzh.ch}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
In 2001 he received the [[Prix Blaise-Pascal]]<ref>[http://smai.emath.fr/spip.php?article21&lang=fr''Prix Blaise-Pascal, Société de Mathématiques Appliquées et Industrielles'']</ref> from the [[French Academy of Sciences]]. He is honorary member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France]].<ref>[https://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/1246-remi-abgrall.html''Institut Universitaire de France'']</ref> In 2008 he got an advanced [[CORDIS]] grant<ref>[https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/226316''Adaptive Schemes for Deterministic and Stochastic Flow Problems, ERC Advanced Grant'']</ref> from the [[European Research Council]]. He was elected as a Fellow of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]], in the 2022 Class of SIAM Fellows, "for fundamental contributions to the development of numerical methods for conservation laws, in particular for multi-fluid flows and residual distribution schemes".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sinews.siam.org/Details-Page/siam-announces-class-of-2022-fellows|title=SIAM Announces Class of 2022 Fellows|date=March 31, 2022|work=SIAM News|access-date=2022-03-31}}</ref>
